**Average bill length (mm) by island for Adelie penguins (24 rows used):**

| Island | Avg bill length (mm) |
|---|---|
| Biscoe | 37.25 |
| Dream | 37.47 |
| Torgersen | 39.21 |

**Problems found and fixes applied:**
- **Island misspellings** (rows 7, 13, 53): "Dram" → "Dream" and "Torgerson" → "Torgersen", per the rules file's allowed labels. Without this, Dream and Torgersen averages would have been split across spurious groups.
- **Exact duplicate rows** (rows 9, 22): removed, so repeated penguins don't double-weight the averages.
- **bill_length_mm**: checked for text/negative values and against the rules range [30, 60] — all clean, no changes needed.

**Caveats:** species labels were clean and Adelie rows needed no exclusions. Other columns not used by this question (body_mass_g stored as text, sex case variants) were left untouched.
